verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Greenhouse applications move through stages. The API can "advance, move and reject applications," and partners can retrieve a candidate's current stage and status, so a stage-based pipeline exists. Nothing in the pack documents recruiter-configurable stages, a drag-to-move UI, or bulk pipeline actions; the only bulk feature cited is outreach campaigns, which is sourcing rather than pipeline management. Missing for 10: per-job custom stage configuration, drag-and-drop candidate movement, bulk actions across pipeline stages, independent or hands-on corroboration.
